tokens.name: purple-600
tokens.usage: Brand primary. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: purple-500
tokens.usage: Brand hover and dark-mode link. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: purple-800
tokens.usage: Brand pressed. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Near-black: light-mode text, dark-mode page background. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Dark surface (replaces legacy #222224). Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Dark border. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text in light mode. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text in dark mode, tertiary in light. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Light-mode border. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Disabled fill and dividers on surface. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Light surface (replaces legacy #F0F0F0). Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: sand-100
tokens.usage: Warm surface for people cards. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White. Base palette value. Only defines semantic tokens; components never reference it directly.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active states and markers. White text on it is 6.25:1; as a fill on the dark page background it is 3.1:1 (fine for a filled control, not for text).

tokens.name: color-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on primary. White label on it is 4.65:1.

tokens.name: color-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed and active fill on primary. White label on it is 11.6:1.

tokens.name: color-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: color-link
tokens.usage: Inline links and the active nav item. 6.25:1 on color-bg in light. In dark it is 4.12:1 on color-bg and 3.37:1 on color-surface, below 4.5:1 for body-size text; the source value is kept.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page and section background.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, input fields and filled tags. Put color-text-primary on it; color-text-secondary on it is 4.26:1 in light (below 4.5:1) and 6.18:1 in dark.

tokens.name: color-surface-warm
tokens.usage: Team and people cards only.

tokens.name: color-inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Secondary button, inverse tags and icon wrappers.

tokens.name: color-inverse-text
tokens.usage: Content on color-inverse-bg.

tokens.name: color-overlay
tokens.usage: Image scrims: ink-950 at 50%.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on color-bg, color-surface and color-surface-warm. 19.2:1 on color-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, descriptions and metadata on color-bg (4.65:1 in light, 7.55:1 in dark). On color-surface in light it is 4.26:1, under 4.5:1.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, breadcrumb trail and index numerals only. 2.54:1 on color-bg in light and 4.12:1 in dark: never use it for body copy.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, tags, dividers and accordion rules. Decorative only: 1.89:1 on color-bg in light, 1.63:1 in dark.

tokens.name: color-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card outlines and input outlines (20% ink-950 in light, 10% white in dark).

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success badges dots and valid inputs. Status only, never a large fill. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning badge dots. Status only. Never use as text on light backgrounds (1.81:1 on white).

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Error badges, invalid inputs and required markers. 4.27:1 on white, 4.49:1 on color-bg in dark. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Informational badge dots. Status only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. Below 768px: 44px / 48px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Sub-section titles and large stats. Below 768px: 32px / 40px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Feature and service titles outside cards. Below 768px: 24px / 32px.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Card titles and team-member names. Below 768px: 20px / 28px.

styles.name: h4-mobile
styles.usage: `h4` below 768px. Body styles (`body-lg` and smaller) do not change on mobile.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Section subtitles, lead paragraphs and accordion titles.

styles.name: body-md
styles.usage: Default body. Set it at weight 700 for button labels, tags and emphasis.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary copy and footer links. Set it at weight 700 for nav and eyebrow badges.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta labels, hints and legal text. Add +1px tracking when UPPERCASE.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudge and icon wrapper padding (24px wrapper).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight stacks and label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Button padding (md), list gaps and the mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card inner stack gap and input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), grid gutters and section-header stack gap.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Default card padding and the desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Large card padding and column gaps in multi-column layouts.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Section header to content, and mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Between sub-sections and tablet section padding.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Desktop section vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon glyph boxes, small chips and colour swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tooltips, small controls and dropdown items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, tables and image thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels and dark CTA or form blocks.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero media and oversized tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, badges, avatars and icon wrappers.

gradient.note: Two uses only: hero colour overlay and soft process cards. Never on buttons, text or borders.

tokens.name: gradient-brand
tokens.usage: Hero image colour overlay (mix-blend-mode: color or multiply) and brand accents.

tokens.name: gradient-soft
tokens.usage: Process and step cards, soft CTA backgrounds.
